scope: Public startup rendering, wallet-cookie restoration, route code loading and navigation; no contract or transaction construction changes.

environment.site: Local Next production builds; standard production WalletConnect inventory enabled on both
environment.rpc: Local Anvil mainnet fork of https://mainnet.gateway.tenderly.co

metricsNote: headerMs and mintMs measure first DOM availability, not paint or transaction readiness. fcpMs measures first contentful paint. Cached local document delivery does not establish hosted CDN latency.

acceptance.publicNavigationInInitialHtml: pass, also exercised with JavaScript disabled
acceptance.throttledMintUnder2s: not met: median 3296.5ms; essentially unchanged from baseline 3296.8ms
acceptance.unusedPanelsAbsentFromHomepageScripts: pass for packs, management, FWA and contract-doc UI markers
acceptance.publicHtmlIndependentOfWalletCookie: pass; identical HTML with invalid wallet cookie and without cookie

economicChecks.method: Independent minimal ABI reads unit and mintFee at the fork block; actual UI quantity changes; zero submitted transactions.

checks.result: Production build and TypeScript pass; bundled public routes prerendered.

checks.result: 10 checks passed; no page errors or transactions.

checks.command: PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_PATH=<installed Chrome> PERF_TARGET=candidate E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3200 PERF_OUTPUT=/tmp/shapes-startup-preload-performance.json node web/e2e/startupPerformance.mjs
checks.result: Three fresh contexts each for desktop and throttled profiles; matching unchanged baseline samples reused.
Gallery, packs, token, manage, auction, contracts and FWA panels rendered without page errors; live data completion was not required.
Cookie-independent cached HTML and no unused-panel script markers.

review: Independent review found and verified repairs for static /admin conflict, deployment/config pairing, optional mint-start parsing, scheduled error visibility, and local override rendering. Final simplified provider path has no remaining actionable review finding.
priorFailures: Dependency reuse initially raced a copy, then a broad copy ignore omitted Next server/web; builds stopped before compilation. Dependencies restored without clearing existing caches. Logs retained in /tmp/shapes-*-build*.log.
Initial lint invocation used repository root instead of web; corrected cwd passed.
An initial deferred runtime added a measurable mint reveal/download delay; removed it and rechecked the affected build, browser checks and candidate performance.
limitations: The 2-second throttled mint target was not reached. Standard wallet stack remains preloaded to avoid delaying the mint panel; unused view panels are lazy.

Cross-device WalletConnect/Coinbase sessions and physical browser extensions were not exercised; actual local Viem wallet connection/reconnection was exercised with the full wallet inventory configured.
No mainnet transaction, deployment, push or merge. Hosted CDN behavior remains unverified.

Local deployment override must be supplied at build and start; a bundled static artifact must be rebuilt to retarget. Conditional local-override rendering was source-reviewed; final performance used bundled mainnet metadata.
Broad contract suites and production asset lifecycles were not run for this frontend-only change.
